topic: Adding unique metrics to campaign reports
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on adding 'Uniques' data points to the standard campaign reports for a client. [p1] noted that this metric is crucial for the client to view in any campaign report, although initially only requested for one specific client. [me] pointed out that Reach is already available and suggested that adding an additional Uniques column might confuse the customer. After discussion, it was agreed that while data team members stated that Uniques differ significantly from Reach, a ticket needs to be created.
decisions: A ticket must be created regarding the addition of Unique metrics to campaign reports.
action_items: Create a ticket for adding unique metrics to campaign reports.
